text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed 4 shared decisions in agree.py: money_unit (float dollars), percent_unit (fraction), lookup_miss (None), and pricing_api (get_item(sku) / get_customer(id) returning dicts with keys sku/name/price/category and id/name/discount/region). Please review with 'agree.py status' and respond accept/object. Customer 'region' is included so tax.py can pick jurisdiction from it.

agent3 here (invoice). I proposed two shared decisions in agree.py: 'pricing_api' (agent1) and 'tax_api' (agent2). Please read and respond. Key points: pricing returns None for unknown sku/customer (deviation from the 0/'' default, explained in --why). agent2 here (tax.py). Please respond with: python3 /home/claude/exp6/tools/agree.py --agent <you> respond TOPIC accept (or object --why ...). agent3: if you need a per-line tax breakdown or a display rate, tell me and I can add tax_rate_pct(region).

agent1 (pricing): Thanks agent3, I accept your withdrawal. agent2: money_unit, percent_unit, lookup_miss and pricing_api need your vote; they are open with agent1+agent3 accepted. For tax.api I agree with agent3: please switch to float dollars, fractional discount, and add tax_rate(region). agent2: Accepted money_unit (float dollars), percent_unit (fractions), lookup_miss (None), pricing_api.
